lines.text: Three days downriver, the banners on the banks changed. Black and gold became purple and black. Crows, on every tower. Corrow land.
At the old toll tower, a barge was waiting for us in the middle of the river. Purple silk awnings. Twenty oars. And on its deck, a lady with a fan.
Corvin took one look, and hid behind Ash.
Don't tell her I'm here. Tell her I drowned. Tell her I drowned twice.
Lord Lucan. How lovely. You look like something the river coughed up. And Corvin. Behind the dog. I can see your feet.
She had brought her children. A solemn boy of about eleven, with his mother's eyes. And a little girl who took one look at Ash and stopped listening to anyone.
Mother. Mother! Can I touch him? Can I? He's the biggest dog in the whole world!
Yes, Odette. Then wash your hands.
Mother says you're the most dangerous man in the kingdom. You don't look dangerous.
Thank you.
It wasn't a compliment.
Rafe and Odette Corrow. Sabine watched them the whole time. It was the only time I ever saw her look at anything without counting it.
Let's not waste each other's time. The Order is hungry, Lord Lucan. It has eaten three great houses in my lifetime. It has decided you'll be the fourth. I'd rather not be the fifth.
So. An alliance. Corrow and Greyhollow, against the Order. My ships, my coin, my friends at court. And in return, a quarter of Saltmouth.
You laughed at me in my father's hall. You sent a forged clause north. And you wrote to the Order, and told them what I was.
All true. And I'd sell you again tomorrow, if the price were right. Today the price is wrong. That's the most honest offer you'll get south of the Senn.
Then ask me again when I trust you.
I'll ask again when you need me. It will be sooner than you think.
She snapped her fan shut. Odette had to be peeled off Ash, one finger at a time.
Goodbye, dog! I'll see you at court!
Oh, and Corvin? Keep my secrets, and I'll keep forgetting you're alive.
...That was her being kind, my lord. That's how she sounds when she's being kind.
Her barge swept away downriver, toward Aldcrown, and the King, and the Order. She would be there before us. Sabine was always there before us.
The Lord Who Measured Zero. Chapter sixty-nine, coming soon.
